principle: Different input forms share one pipeline. Preserve raw input and provenance; resolve only what is undecided; never delete existing Pulse information.

stages.name: Input
stages.purpose: Give humans, apps, and procedural systems multiple interfaces for putting information into MOOR without creating separate learning pipelines.
accepts: Wonder Feed genomes and saved wonders
stages.output: A normalized Stream record that preserves the original payload and its source/provenance.
rules: Human and procedural inputs use the same transport.
Source/type/provenance stay explicit even when the downstream path is identical.
Never replace or delete the source artifact when ingesting it.
Existing input applications remain independently openable.
done_criteria: Pulse exposes Project Pulse, Moor Canvas, Procedural Generators, Moor Ultra OS, and Wonder Feed as input surfaces.
Quick text input can append a new record to Stream.
Saved Wonder Feed and Moor Canvas outputs can be harvested without deleting their existing storage.
Every ingested record retains source and type.

stages.name: Stream
stages.purpose: Be the append-only arrival lane for information entering MOOR before the system decides what it means or where it belongs.
stages.output: Chronological records that can be kept in Bin or sent to Funnel.
rules: Raw payload is preserved.
The Stream does not decide truth or mutate source artifacts.
Identical harvested artifacts may be deduplicated by stable identity, not by deleting originals.
Every record can retain provenance and relationships.
done_criteria: Stream shows chronological local records.
A record can be kept in Bin.
A record can be sent to Funnel.
The same stored record is reused rather than silently rewritten.

stages.name: Discover
stages.purpose: Find relevant, novel, or reusable things from Stream and the component inventory without pretending discovery is canonical truth.
stages.output: Ranked candidates that can be opened, kept, or sent to Funnel.
rules: Ranking is deterministic for the same local state.
Discovery never modifies its source.
Recommendations retain provenance.
Discovery can work without an LLM.
done_criteria: Discover ranks real Pulse components against recent Stream context.
Candidates can be opened.
Candidates can be sent to Funnel.
No invented scores or fake histories are displayed.

stages.name: Bin
stages.purpose: Be the durable searchable inventory for components, artifacts, blueprints, and knowledge without erasing superseded history.
rules: Everything remains addressable even if another surface also presents it.
Supersede or hide rather than destructively delete history.
Keep provenance and source identity.
The Bin is storage/inventory, not a builder.
done_criteria: Every existing Pulse component remains reachable from Bin.
All five spine blueprints are visible in Bin.
Kept Stream records persist across reloads.
Search covers existing components plus spine knowledge.

stages.name: Funnel
stages.purpose: Run the canonical v43 two-sided resolver: ask the important questions, let either the user or system side answer them, and lock only valid resolved answers before execution.
stages.output: Locked pages/requirements with provenance and a verdict packet for downstream execution.
rules: The Funnel is not the builder.
The user side and system side resolve the same questions.
Only valid answer paths are offered; unresolved ambiguity is surfaced rather than disguised.
Explicit requirements survive as separate obligations.
Known locked answers are reused; only missing, changed, conflicting, or downstream-affected decisions are recomputed.
done_criteria: Pulse keeps the existing Funnel project/version surface and actual Funnel app reachable.
The five stage blueprints are frozen together as a Funnel project.
Any stage can place a record into a persistent Funnel inbox.
Existing Funnel project/version data is preserved.

downstream.engine_harness: Consumes resolved knowledge later; intentionally not one of this five-stage Pulse reorganization.
downstream.result: Verified output and user verdict feed future learning deposits without changing the current run retroactively.
